evidence.says: stores 40.0 at +0xD0 and +0xD8, 45.0 at +0xD4 and +0xDC, 10.0 at +0xE0, 15.0 at +0xE4, the helper at +0xE8; the virtual table 0x5911848 at +0, 0x5911758 at +0x28 (the ecs::System part)
the live manager (the system object minus 0x28) holds 40, 45, 40, 45, 10, 15 at those offsets; staged creatures wake at 39 m and not at 40.5 m, sleep at 45.4 m and not at 44.8 m
